en.headline: Police arrest 23 in Mong Kok raid on suspected illegal gambling den
en.dek: Officers from the Mong Kok special duties squad raided a unit on Soy Street on Wednesday, seizing seven mahjong tables and about HK$20,000 in cash while detaining 23 people for investigation.
body: Police arrested 23 people on Wednesday during an anti-gambling operation in Mong Kok that targeted a suspected illegal gambling establishment.

The Mong Kok special duties squad conducted the raid, codenamed Fullboom, on a unit on Soy Street after intelligence analysis. A 48-year-old local woman was arrested on suspicion of managing a gambling establishment, and a 45-year-old local woman on suspicion of assisting in the management. Another 21 people, mostly local residents aged 30 to 65, were arrested on suspicion of gambling in a gambling establishment. All are being held for investigation.

Officers seized seven mahjong tables, about HK$20,000 in cash and gambling equipment. Police reminded the public that managing a gambling establishment and gambling in such a place are serious offences under the Gambling Ordinance.

zh.headline: 警旺角豉油街搗破非法賭檔拘捕23人
zh.dek: 旺角特別職務隊周三突擊搜查豉油街一單位，搗破懷疑非法賭檔，檢獲7張麻雀柁及約2萬元現金，拘捕23人。
body: 警方周三在旺角展開反賭博行動，突擊搜查豉油街一單位，搗破一個懷疑非法賭檔，共拘捕23人。
旺角特別職務隊在情報分析後進行代號「蓄勢」的行動。一名48歲本地女子涉嫌管理賭博場所被捕，一名45歲本地女子涉嫌協助管理賭博場所被捕。另外21人，大多為30至65歲本地居民，涉嫌在賭博場所內賭博被捕。所有被捕人現正被扣留調查。
行動中檢獲7張麻雀柁、約2萬元現金及一批賭具。警方重申，根據《賭博條例》，管理賭博場所及在場所內賭博屬嚴重罪行。
